policy: Official alerts are selected source-linked public health notices. They are not a complete surveillance dataset and should not be read as a live outbreak map.

alerts.title: Hantavirus cluster linked to cruise ship travel, multi-country
alerts.summary: WHO reported a cruise-associated hantavirus cluster involving Andes virus and assessed the global population risk as low while investigations and contact tracing continued.
alerts.riskLanguage: Event-specific. Does not indicate a general local U.S. risk map or a live local case service.

alerts.title: Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome alert in the Americas Region
alerts.geography: Americas Region, especially Southern Cone countries
alerts.summary: PAHO/WHO issued an alert after increases in reported hantavirus infections during 2025 in endemic countries of the Americas, particularly the Southern Cone, and urged strengthened surveillance and risk reduction.
alerts.riskLanguage: Regional aggregate context. It should not be read as a neighborhood-level or travel-specific risk prediction.

alerts.title: Hantavirus confirmed in Santa Fe County resident
alerts.summary: NMDOH reported a Santa Fe County resident hospitalized with HPS who had recovered, and reminded residents to air out cabins, sheds, garages, and other spaces before spring cleaning.
alerts.riskLanguage: Single official state notice. It does not create a county-level active risk map.

alerts.title: Increased hantavirus activity in Arizona
alerts.summary: ADHS advised healthcare providers to consider hantavirus in compatible illness with rodent exposure after increased 2024 activity.
alerts.riskLanguage: Provider-oriented advisory. Values in the notice are a point-in-time snapshot.

alerts.title: Preventing hantavirus infection in the workplace
alerts.summary: CDPH highlighted worker risk in jobs that involve rodents or enclosed structures where deer mice may have infested, including parks, campgrounds, and maintenance work.
alerts.riskLanguage: Prevention-oriented notice. It is not a case-count alert.
